summary: FigJam boards — sticky notes, text, shapes, sections, stamps and connectors on one or more pages, previewed as a picture of the board and drawn into a FigJam file by the Graffiticode FigJam plugin. Succeeds L0172.
in_scope: Shapes with text: basic, flowchart (decision, process, terminator, input/output), engineering (database, queue, file, folder) and decorative (star, shield, speech bubble, arrows)
Sections that group nodes under a title
Connectors between nodes: labelled, straight, elbowed or curved, dashed, with arrowheads and attachment sides, fanning out to a list or to every node
Colours, outlines, opacity and text sizes
Boards with several pages, shown as tabs
Drawing the board into a FigJam file the user links, with the Graffiticode FigJam plugin
out_of_scope: Figma design files (frames, components, variants, auto layout) do NOT belong here, and neither do other whiteboards (Miro, Mural, Lucidspark, Excalidraw).
Concept maps and webs that learners complete by dragging answers are L0183; do NOT route them here.
Charts and graphs of numbers are L0184; spreadsheets are L0179; quizzes are L0180 — do NOT route them here.
Images, tables, comments, FigJam widgets and automatic layout are not built yet.
Reading or editing what is already on a FigJam board is not built yet; L0186 only adds the board it describes.
L0186 does NOT accept L0172 programs: it is a different language, and existing L0172 items stay with L0172.
